points.point: Does a 429 response include a Retry-After header?
Does a 429 response include an X-RateLimit-Remaining header?

verdict.reason: The closest entry, rate-limit, covers the 30-requests-per-minute limits and says to wait "when the response supplies one," but none of its sentences state whether the 429 response includes a Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Remaining header, so the customer's header question goes unanswered.
